description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Infineon Technologies is hiring a Graduate Product Engineer to support semiconductor product development from R&D backend operations through production ramp-up. The role focuses on optimizing workflows, supporting product debugging, planning qualifications, and coordinating with factory operations.
Graduate Product Engineer leading R&D operations, streamlining product development, maintaining debug benches, and planning product qualification

Responsibilities:
• Lead R&D backend operations to ensure efficient product development
• Reduce cycle times and optimize workflows to minimize project costs
• Create and maintain bench setups for simple product debugging and checkout
• Document qualification requirements and develop qualification plans for robust product development
• Work with factory operations teams to ensure smooth production ramp-up of new products

Requirements:
• Graduating in the Fall 202 or Spring 2027 with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Computer Engineering
• Understanding of analog/digital circuits, power devices, and high-speed signal integrity
• Skilled in creating and sustaining process-driven methods for product development
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills
• Ability to break down complex engineering standards and workflows into actionable, easy-to-understand steps
• A self-starter with a collaborative mindset and ability to work independently when required
• US citizen or green card holder: This position requires access to documentation that is controlled by the export laws of the United States. Candidates are required to provide proof of either US citizenship, Permanent US residency, or classification as a protected individual as defined in 8USC 1324b(a)(3)
